coding_rules: Rule 1: never use current_user_can() with a custom-ability slug
Rule 2: REST permission_callback must not use the bare '__return_true' (allowlist enforced in bin/coding-rules-check.sh)

Rule 3: never import a Free CONCRETE class directly (use container or filter hooks; the only acknowledged exception is MediaRepository — Phase 1 added MediaRepositoryInterface + TemplateHelpersInterface to retire even that)
Rule 4: platform-coupled code lives under includes/Integrations/<Platform>/ (never under capability-named subdirs like Storage/, AI/, Connectors/Flickr/)

Rule 5 (added 2026-05-02, Phase 6): every wp_ajax_* registration is on the documented 5-handler allowlist (mvs_pro_test_s3, mvs_pro_test_bunny, mvs_save_connector_prefs, mvs_migration_batch, mvs_migration_reset). Off-list registrations fail the gate; new functionality must use a REST route. Each allowlisted registration must carry an inline `Rule A allowlist:` comment.

Rule 6 (added 2026-05-03, RC walkthrough): every block render.php that instantiates a WPMediaVersePro\Frontend\Layouts\* class MUST call $layout->enqueue_assets() in the same file. WordPress does NOT auto-enqueue per-layout stylesheets when the block path is taken — only the LayoutManager site-wide path does. Idempotent (wp_enqueue_* dedupes by handle), so it does not double-enqueue when the LayoutManager site-wide path also runs.
Feature toggles required — every new Pro feature gated by get_option('mvs_*_enabled')

CLI importer base class — the 3 importers (Integrations/{RtMedia,MediaPress,BuddyBoss}/Importer.php) extend WPMediaVersePro\Integrations\AbstractBatchImporter (Phase 5 P2.2). New importers go under includes/Integrations/<Platform>/Importer.php (Rule 4) and extend the base.

Admin migration card pattern — each platform-specific MigrationAdmin extends WPMediaVersePro\Integrations\AbstractMigrationAdmin (Phase 5 P2.1); the generic Admin/MigrationPage shell hosts one card per registered MigrationAdmin and dispatches AJAX by platform slug
Admin page pattern follows Free (no standalone admin pages outside WPMediaVerse menu)

Layout interface contract — every layout in Frontend/Layouts/ implements LayoutMode::render_feed(array $args = []): string (Phase 3a). Returns ONLY the feed body markup — never get_header()/get_footer() — so blocks + shortcodes can embed the output anywhere.

rest_changed: POST /mvs-pro/v1/media/{id}/story - now returns 400 mvs_story_invalid_type when the target is not something the stories viewer can render. Previously accepted ANY media id with no type check anywhere in the flow, so a document would have become a story in a full-bleed image viewer.
contract_changes: StoryService::create() returns '' when it declines the item (was: always an expiry string). The controller converts that to the 400 above rather than reporting is_story: true for a row that is not a story (Free Coding Rule 20).
methods_added: LeaderboardService::base_condition(string $window): string (private) - the population every ranking query shares. Extracted because get_page() and get_viewer_rank() each carried a hand-maintained copy, and a viewer rank computed over a different set than the page beside it is a correctness bug. Returns baked literals, not placeholders: get_page()'s total query runs WITHOUT prepare(), so a %s left in the fragment would reach MySQL verbatim.
behavior_changes: Leaderboard rankings (media_count and reactions, all windows, page and viewer-rank) count the MEDIA library only. media_count must count what its name says (Coding Rule 13), and documents are cheap to produce in bulk - an unfiltered COUNT(*) let a member top a public ranking with files nobody browses there.
Stories list filters by type as well, as defence in depth for is_story meta written before the guard existed.
InstagramLayout feed - a photo grid that selected * with no type predicate.
dead_code_removed: CompeteSummaryController::get_user_challenges() - the LEFT JOIN to Free's mvs_media_index. It selected m.file_url and never read it; the card image resolves through the media repository. Same redundant join this file already dropped once in 1.3.0, re-grown in the sibling query. Removing it also takes the method off the type surface entirely - it looks up entries a member already submitted.
bugs_fixed_from_prior_delta: Integrations\AlbumMarkerLookupTrait::find_existing_album() called $this->find_existing_by_dedup(), which exists on AbstractBatchImporter but NOT on AbstractMigrationAdmin, the trait's other host. Fatal on the legacy-marker branch that every pre-2.4.0 site takes. Now resolves the Free repository directly. Shipped in 9680c9e (the 2.4.0 importer fix), caught by PHPStan.
free_dependency_added: \WPMediaVerse\Core\MediaTypes (Free 2.4.0) - reached fully-qualified, not imported, matching the SettingsHelper / MVS_CSS precedent. Pro Coding Rule 3 forbids `use WPMediaVerse\...\<ConcreteClass>` imports; a fully-qualified static call to a stateless vocabulary class is the sanctioned form and passes bin/coding-rules-check.sh.
